company.description: Telegram is a cloud-based, cross-platform instant messaging service focusing on speed, security, and massive group capabilities, offering end-to-end encryption for secret chats and voice calls. It allows users to share files of any type, creates groups of up to 200,000 members, and manages channels for broadcasting to unlimited audiences, all while syncing seamlessly across devices.
